info.description:
Every request here is also in the OpenAPI / Swagger spec, with the same request body and response examples (generated from one catalog).

Setup:
1. Import Taxteck.postman_environment.json and select it.
2. Set baseUrl, appEmail, appPassword. Run 0. Auth > Login (session), then Create API token: the token is saved to apiToken automatically.
3. Fill companyId, companyName, tan and the TRACES / IT credentials (secret variables).

Notes:
- Cookies are disabled on every request except Login and Create API token. Keep it that way: a session cookie on an API call makes the server ask for a CSRF token.
- RPC requests (/api/rpc/*) return HTTP 200 even for errors; check the error field. Each RPC request has a saved Success and Error example.
- Synchronous portal requests can take several minutes: set Settings > Request timeout to 0 (no timeout) or at least 900000 ms.

**Fetch LDC certificates from TRACES (Income-tax Act 2025, tax year 2026-27 onwards)**

Mode: Synchronous (portal call).

Synchronous: the HTTP call stays open until the portal work finishes (typically 1-10 minutes). Use a client timeout of at least 15 minutes.

Steps: TRACES login (captcha solved automatically) → search certificates → download ready PDFs → raise download requests for missing PDFs → read certificate details → save. Certificates whose PDF TRACES has not prepared yet are listed in data.missingCertNumbers (their rows are still saved; call again later to collect the PDFs). Saved on (companyId, certNumber, fy), so repeat calls never duplicate.

request.description:
**Fetch LDC certificates from TRACES (Income-tax Act 1961, FY up to 2025-26)**

Mode: Synchronous (portal call).

Synchronous: the HTTP call stays open until the portal work finishes (typically 1-10 minutes). Use a client timeout of at least 15 minutes.

Reads the TRACES 197 inbox, downloads each new certificate PDF (kept as certificates/{certNumber}.pdf), then verifies every certificate on the 197 certificate verification page (section, nature, rate, limit, consumed, dates, cancellation). A certificate with a cancel date is saved with isActive=false. Certificates already stored for the company and FY are not downloaded again.
